sections.title: The proverbs of Solomon
sections.text: The proverbs of Solomon to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding; to receive instruction in wise dealing to give prudence to the simple that the wise man may hear

sections.title: to understand a proverb
sections.text: to understand a proverb The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son for they will be a garland to grace your head

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son If they say let's swallow them up alive like Sheol We'll find all valuable wealth. We'll fill our houses with spoil. You shall cast your lot among us. We'll all have one purse.

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood. For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives. So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

sections.title: Wisdom calls aloud in the street...
sections.text: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares. She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates How long Turn at my reproof. Behold Because I have called
sections.summary: Wisdom personified calling out to the simple and scoffers

sections.title: but you have ignored all my counsel...
sections.text: but you have ignored all my counsel I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you; when calamity overtakes you like a storm Then will they call on me because they hated knowledge

sections.title: They wanted none of my counsel...
sections.text: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof. Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them. But whoever listens to me will dwell securely
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son So as to turn your ear to wisdom Yes If you seek her as silver then you will understand the fear of Yahweh

sections.title: For Yahweh gives wisdom...
sections.text: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding. He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity; that he may guard the paths of justice Then you will understand righteousness and justice For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: Discretion will watch over you...
sections.text: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you to deliver you from the way of evil who forsake the paths of uprightness who rejoice to do evil who are crooked in their ways

sections.title: To deliver you from the strange woman...
sections.text: To deliver you from the strange woman who forsakes the friend of her youth for her house leads down to death None who go to her return again that you may walk in the way of good men
sections.summary: Warning against sexual immorality with consequences

sections.title: For the upright will dwell in the land...
sections.text: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it. But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son for length of days Don't let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart. So you will find favor Trust in Yahweh with all your heart

sections.title: In all your ways acknowledge him...
sections.text: In all your ways acknowledge him Don't be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh It will be health to your body Honor Yahweh with your substance so your barns will be filled with plenty

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son for whom Yahweh loves Happy is the man who finds wisdom For her good profit is better than getting silver She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

sections.title: Length of days is in her right hand...
sections.text: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor. Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace. She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her. By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding By his knowledge
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son so they will be life to your soul Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won't stumble. When you lie down Don't be afraid of sudden fear

sections.title: for Yahweh will be your confidence...
sections.text: for Yahweh will be your confidence Don't withhold good from those to whom it is due Don't say to your neighbor Don't devise evil against your neighbor Don't strive with a man without cause

sections.title: Don't envy the man of violence...
sections.text: Don't envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways. For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh Yahweh's curse is in the house of the wicked Surely he mocks the mockers The wise will inherit glory

sections.title: Listen
sections.text: Listen for I give you sound learning. Don't forsake my law. For I was a son to my father He taught me Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don't forget

sections.title: Don't forsake her
sections.text: Don't forsake her Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes Esteem her She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.

sections.title: Listen
sections.text: Listen I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths. When you go Take firm hold of instruction. Don't let her go. Keep her Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of evil men.

sections.title: Avoid it
sections.text: Avoid it For they don't sleep For they eat the bread of wickedness But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don't know what they stumble over.

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the midst of your heart. For they are life to those who find them Keep your heart with all diligence Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

sections.title: Let your eyes look straight ahead...
sections.text: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you. Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established. Don't turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son that you may maintain discretion For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil But in the end she is as bitter as wormwood Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
sections.summary: Warning against sexual immorality with consequences

sections.title: She gives no thought to the way of life...
sections.text: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked Now therefore Remove your way far from her. Don't come near the door of her house lest you give your honor to others lest strangers feast on your wealth

sections.title: You will groan at your latter end...
sections.text: You will groan at your latter end and say neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers I have come to the brink of utter ruin Drink water out of your own cistern

sections.title: Should your springs overflow in the stre...
sections.text: Should your springs overflow in the streets Let them be for yourself alone Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth. A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love. For why should you

sections.title: For the ways of man are before the eyes ...
sections.text: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Yahweh. He examines all his paths. The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly. He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth. Do this now Give no sleep to your eyes Free yourself

sections.title: Go to the ant
sections.text: Go to the ant which having no chief provides her bread in the summer How long will you sleep A little sleep
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: so your poverty will come as a robber...
sections.text: so your poverty will come as a robber A worthless person who winks with his eyes in whose heart is perverseness Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly

sections.title: There are six things which Yahweh hates;...
sections.text: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes haughty eyes a heart that devises wicked schemes a false witness who utters lies

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck. When you walk For the commandment is a lamp to keep you from the immoral woman

sections.title: Don't lust after her beauty in your hear...
sections.text: Don't lust after her beauty in your heart For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life. Can a man scoop fire into his lap Or can one walk on hot coals So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
sections.summary: Warning against sexual immorality with consequences

sections.title: Men don't despise a thief
sections.text: Men don't despise a thief but if he is found He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul. He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away. For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won't spare in the day of vengeance.

sections.title: He won't regard any ransom
sections.text: He won't regard any ransom
sections.summary: Standalone wisdom on: He won't regard any ransom...

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye. Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart. Tell wisdom that they may keep you from the strange woman
sections.summary: Warning against sexual immorality with consequences

sections.title: For at the window of my house
sections.text: For at the window of my house I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding passing through the street near her corner in the twilight Behold

sections.title: She is loud and defiant...
sections.text: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don't stay in her house. Now she is in the streets So she caught him Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. This day I have paid my vows. Therefore I came out to meet you
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: I have spread my couch with carpets of t...
sections.text: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry I have perfumed my bed with myrrh Come For my husband isn't at home. He has gone on a long journey. He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.

sections.title: With persuasive words
sections.text: With persuasive words He followed her immediately Until an arrow strikes through his liver Now therefore Don't let your heart turn to her ways. Don't go astray in her paths

sections.title: for she has thrown down many wounded...
sections.text: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes Her house is the way to Sheol

sections.title: Doesn't wisdom cry out? Doesn't understa...
sections.text: Doesn't wisdom cry out? Doesn't understanding raise her voice? On the top of high places by the way Beside the gates To you men You simple

sections.title: Hear
sections.text: Hear For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips. All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them. They are all plain to him who understands Receive my instruction rather than silver; knowledge rather than choice gold.

sections.title: For wisdom is better than rubies...
sections.text: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can't be compared to it. I The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power. By me kings reign
sections.summary: Divine principles for leadership and governance

sections.title: By me princes rule; nobles
sections.text: By me princes rule; nobles I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me. With me are riches My fruit is better than gold I walk in the way of righteousness

sections.title: That I may give wealth to those who love...
sections.text: That I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries. Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work I was set up from everlasting When there were no depths Before the mountains were settled in place

sections.title: while as yet he had not made the earth...
sections.text: while as yet he had not made the earth When he established the heavens when he established the clouds above when he gave to the sea its boundary then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day

sections.title: Rejoicing in his whole world...
sections.text: Rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men. Now therefore Hear instruction Blessed is the man who hears me For whoever finds me

sections.title: But he who sins against me wrongs his ow...
sections.text: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.
sections.summary: Standalone wisdom on: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. Al...

sections.title: Wisdom has built her house...
sections.text: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars. She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table. She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city: Whoever is simple Come

sections.title: Leave your simple ways
sections.text: Leave your simple ways He who corrects a mocker invites insult. He who reproves a wicked man invites abuse. Don't reprove a scoffer Instruct a wise man The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

sections.title: For by me your days will be multiplied...
sections.text: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased. If you are wise The foolish woman is loud She sits at the door of her house To call to those who pass by

sections.title: Whoever is simple
sections.text: Whoever is simple Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant. But he doesn't know that the dead are there
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: The proverbs of Solomon...
sections.text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother. Treasures of wickedness profit nothing Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand He who gathers in summer is a wise son
sections.summary: Contrast between diligent and lazy approaches to work and provision

sections.title: Blessings are on the head of the righteo...
sections.text: Blessings are on the head of the righteous The memory of the righteous is blessed The wise in heart accept commandments He who walks blamelessly walks surely One winking with the eye causes sorrow

sections.title: The mouth of the righteous is a spring o...
sections.text: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life Hatred stirs up strife Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment Wise men lay up knowledge The rich man's wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

sections.title: The labor of the righteous leads to life...
sections.text: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin. He is in the way of life who heeds correction He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool. In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

sections.title: The lips of the righteous feed many...
sections.text: The lips of the righteous feed many Yahweh's blessing brings wealth It is a fool's pleasure to do wickedness What the wicked fear When the whirlwind passes

sections.title: As vinegar to the teeth
sections.text: As vinegar to the teeth The fear of Yahweh prolongs days The prospect of the righteous is joy The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright The righteous will never be removed

sections.title: The mouth of the righteous brings forth ...
sections.text: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable

sections.title: A false balance is an abomination to Yah...
sections.text: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh When pride comes The integrity of the upright shall guide them Riches don't profit in the day of wrath The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way

sections.title: The righteousness of the upright shall d...
sections.text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them When a wicked man dies A righteous person is delivered out of trouble With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor When it goes well with the righteous

sections.title: By the blessing of the upright
sections.text: By the blessing of the upright One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom One who brings gossip betrays a confidence Where there is no wise guidance He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it

sections.title: A gracious woman obtains honor
sections.text: A gracious woman obtains honor The merciful man does good to his own soul Wicked people earn deceitful wages He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death. Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh

sections.title: Most certainly
sections.text: Most certainly Like a gold ring in a pig's snout The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath. There is one who scatters The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

sections.title: People curse someone who withholds grain...
sections.text: People curse someone who withholds grain He who diligently seeks good seeks favor He who trusts in his riches will fall He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart. The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: Behold
sections.text: Behold

sections.title: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge...
sections.text: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh A man shall not be established by wickedness A worthy woman is the crown of her husband The thoughts of the righteous are just

sections.title: The words of the wicked are about lying ...
sections.text: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood The wicked are overthrown A man shall be commended according to his wisdom Better is he who is lightly esteemed A righteous man respects the life of his animal

sections.title: He who tills his land shall have plenty ...
sections.text: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread The wicked desires the plunder of evil men An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man's hands shall be rewarded to him. The way of a fool is right in his own eyes

sections.title: A fool shows his annoyance the same day...
sections.text: A fool shows his annoyance the same day He who is truthful testifies honestly There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword Truth's lips will be established forever Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil

sections.title: No mischief shall happen to the righteou...
sections.text: No mischief shall happen to the righteous Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh A prudent man keeps his knowledge The hands of the diligent ones shall rule Anxiety in a man's heart weighs it down

sections.title: A righteous person is cautious in friend...
sections.text: A righteous person is cautious in friendship The slothful man doesn't roast his game In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

sections.title: A wise son listens to his father's instr...
sections.text: A wise son listens to his father's instruction By the fruit of his lips He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin. The soul of the sluggard desires A righteous man hates lies
sections.summary: Contrast between diligent and lazy approaches to work and provision

sections.title: Righteousness guards the way of integrit...
sections.text: Righteousness guards the way of integrity There are some who pretend to be rich The ransom of a man's life is his riches The light of the righteous shines brightly Pride only breeds quarrels

sections.title: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away...
sections.text: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away Hope deferred makes the heart sick Whoever despises instruction will pay for it The teaching of the wise is a spring of life Good understanding wins favor; but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

sections.title: Every prudent man acts from knowledge...
sections.text: Every prudent man acts from knowledge A wicked messenger falls into trouble Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul One who walks with wise men grows wise

sections.title: Misfortune pursues sinners
sections.text: Misfortune pursues sinners A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children An abundance of food is in poor people's fields One who spares the rod hates his son The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul

sections.title: Every wise woman builds her house...
sections.text: Every wise woman builds her house He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh The fool's talk brings a rod to his back Where no oxen are A truthful witness will not lie

sections.title: A scoffer seeks wisdom
sections.text: A scoffer seeks wisdom Stay away from a foolish man The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way Fools mock at making atonement for sins The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

sections.title: The house of the wicked will be overthro...
sections.text: The house of the wicked will be overthrown There is a way which seems right to a man Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways. A simple man believes everything

sections.title: A wise man fears
sections.text: A wise man fears He who is quick to become angry will commit folly The simple inherit folly The evil bow down before the good The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor

sections.title: He who despises his neighbor sins...
sections.text: He who despises his neighbor sins Don't they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good. In all hard work there is profit The crown of the wise is their riches A truthful witness saves souls

sections.title: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortre...
sections.text: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life In the multitude of people is the king's glory He who is slow to anger has great understanding The life of the body is a heart at peace
sections.summary: Divine principles for leadership and governance

sections.title: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt...
sections.text: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker The wicked is brought down in his calamity Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding Righteousness exalts a nation The king's favor is toward a servant who deals wisely
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: A gentle answer turns away wrath...
sections.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath The tongue of the wise commends knowledge Yahweh's eyes are everywhere A gentle tongue is a tree of life A fool despises his father's correction

sections.title: In the house of the righteous is much tr...
sections.text: In the house of the righteous is much treasure The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools. The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.

sections.title: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh&#821...
sections.text: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men! A scoffer doesn't love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise. A glad heart makes a cheerful face; but an aching heart breaks the spirit. The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge All the days of the afflicted are wretched

sections.title: Better is little
sections.text: Better is little Better is a dinner of herbs A wrathful man stirs up contention The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch A wise son makes a father glad
sections.summary: Contrast between diligent and lazy approaches to work and provision

sections.title: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdo...
sections.text: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom Where there is no counsel Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time! The path of life leads upward for the wise Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud

sections.title: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicke...
sections.text: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house The heart of the righteous weighs answers Yahweh is far from the wicked The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

sections.title: The ear that listens to reproof lives...
sections.text: The ear that listens to reproof lives He who refuses correction despises his own soul The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

sections.title: The plans of the heart belong to man...
sections.text: The plans of the heart belong to man All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives. Commit your deeds to Yahweh Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.

sections.title: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned fo...
sections.text: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil. When a man's ways please Yahweh Better is a little with righteousness A man's heart plans his course Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
sections.summary: Divine principles for leadership and governance

sections.title: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh's;...
sections.text: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh's; all the weights in the bag are his work. It is an abomination for kings to do wrong Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth. The king's wrath is a messenger of death In the light of the king's face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
sections.summary: Divine principles for leadership and governance

sections.title: How much better it is to get wisdom than...
sections.text: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul. Pride goes before destruction It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

sections.title: The wise in heart shall be called pruden...
sections.text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction. Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it The heart of the wise instructs his mouth Pleasant words are a honeycomb There is a way which seems right to a man
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: The appetite of the laboring man labors ...
sections.text: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on. A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire. A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends. A man of violence entices his neighbor One who winks his eyes to plot perversities

sections.title: Gray hair is a crown of glory...
sections.text: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness. One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit The lot is cast into the lap

sections.title: Better is a dry morsel with quietness...
sections.text: Better is a dry morsel with quietness A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame The refining pot is for silver An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue. Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: Children's children are the crown of old...
sections.text: Children's children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents. Arrogant speech isn't fitting for a fool A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends. A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: An evil man seeks only rebellion; theref...
sections.text: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him. Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man Whoever rewards evil for good The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam He who justifies the wicked

sections.title: Why is there money in the hand of a fool...
sections.text: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity. A man void of understanding strikes hands He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction. One who has a perverse heart doesn't find prosperity

sections.title: He who becomes the father of a fool grie...
sections.text: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy. A cheerful heart makes good medicine A wicked man receives a bribe in secret Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding A foolish son brings grief to his father

sections.title: Also to punish the righteous is not good...
sections.text: Also to punish the righteous is not good He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding. Even a fool

sections.title: An unfriendly man pursues selfishness...
sections.text: An unfriendly man pursues selfishness A fool has no delight in understanding When wickedness comes The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook. To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good

sections.title: A fool's lips come into strife
sections.text: A fool's lips come into strife A fool's mouth is his destruction The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person's innermost parts. One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction. The name of Yahweh is a strong tower: the righteous run to him

sections.title: The rich man's wealth is his strong city...
sections.text: The rich man's wealth is his strong city Before destruction the heart of man is proud He who gives answer before he hears A man's spirit will sustain him in sickness The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

sections.title: A man's gift makes room for him...
sections.text: A man's gift makes room for him He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him. The lot settles disputes A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city; and disputes are like the bars of a castle. A man's stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

sections.title: Death and life are in the power of the t...
sections.text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit. Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing The poor plead for mercy A man of many companions may be ruined

sections.title: Better is the poor who walks in his inte...
sections.text: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool. It isn't good to have zeal without knowledge; nor being hasty with one's feet and missing the way. The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh. Wealth adds many friends A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

sections.title: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler...
sections.text: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good. A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish. Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool

sections.title: The discretion of a man makes him slow t...
sections.text: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense. The king's wrath is like the roaring of a lion A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife's quarrels are a continual dripping. House and riches are an inheritance from fathers Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

sections.title: He who keeps the commandment keeps his s...
sections.text: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him. Discipline your son A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty

sections.title: Listen to counsel and receive instructio...
sections.text: Listen to counsel and receive instruction There are many plans in a man's heart That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar. The fear of Yahweh leads to life The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

sections.title: Flog a scoffer
sections.text: Flog a scoffer He who robs his father and drives away his mother If you stop listening to instruction A corrupt witness mocks justice Penalties are prepared for scoffers

sections.title: Wine is a mocker
sections.text: Wine is a mocker The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life. It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be quarreling. The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
sections.summary: Contrast between diligent and lazy approaches to work and provision

sections.title: Many men claim to be men of unfailing lo...
sections.text: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him. A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes. Who can say Differing weights and differing measures

sections.title: Even a child makes himself known by his ...
sections.text: Even a child makes himself known by his doings The hearing ear Don't love sleep It's no good There is gold and abundance of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

sections.title: Take the garment of one who puts up coll...
sections.text: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman. Fraudulent food is sweet to a man Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war! He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don't keep company with him who opens wide his lips. Whoever curses his father or his mother

sections.title: An inheritance quickly gained at the beg...
sections.text: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning Don't say Yahweh detests differing weights A man's steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way? It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication

sections.title: A wise king winnows out the wicked...
sections.text: A wise king winnows out the wicked The spirit of man is Yahweh's lamp Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love. The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair. Wounding blows cleanse away evil

sections.title: The king's heart is in Yahweh's hand lik...
sections.text: The king's heart is in Yahweh's hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires. Every way of a man is right in his own eyes To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice. A high look The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
sections.summary: Divine principles for leadership and governance

sections.title: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a...
sections.text: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death. The violence of the wicked will drive them away The way of the guilty is devious It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

sections.title: When the mocker is punished
sections.text: When the mocker is punished The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor A gift in secret pacifies anger; and a bribe in the cloak It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

sections.title: The man who wanders out of the way of un...
sections.text: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the dead. He who loves pleasure shall be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil shall not be rich. The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; the treacherous for the upright. It is better to dwell in a desert land There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.

sections.title: He who follows after righteousness and k...
sections.text: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life A wise man scales the city of the mighty Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles. The proud and haughty man The desire of the sluggard kills him

sections.title: There are those who covet greedily all d...
sections.text: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don't withhold. The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: how much more A false witness will perish A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

sections.text: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.

A prudent man sees danger The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.

sections.title: Train up a child in the way he should go...
sections.text: Train up a child in the way he should go The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender. He who sows wickedness reaps trouble He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor. Drive out the mocker

sections.title: He who loves purity of heart and speaks ...
sections.text: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king's friend. The eyes of Yahweh watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful. The sluggard says The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit: he who is under Yahweh's wrath will fall into it. Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

sections.title: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own i...
sections.text: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich Turn your ear For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you That your trust may be in Yahweh Haven't I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge

sections.title: To teach you truth
sections.text: To teach you truth Don't exploit the poor for Yahweh will plead their case Don't befriend a hot-tempered man lest you learn his ways

sections.title: Don't you be one of those who strike han...
sections.text: Don't you be one of those who strike hands If you don't have means to pay Don't move the ancient boundary stone Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won't serve obscure men.

sections.title: When you sit to eat with a ruler...
sections.text: When you sit to eat with a ruler put a knife to your throat Don't be desirous of his dainties Don't weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

sections.title: Don't eat the food of him who has a stin...
sections.text: Don't eat the food of him who has a stingy eye for as he thinks about the cost The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up Don't speak in the ears of a fool Don't move the ancient boundary stone. Don't encroach on the fields of the fatherless:

sections.title: for their Defender is strong...
sections.text: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you. Apply your heart to instruction Don't withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod Punish him with the rod

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son yes Don't let your heart envy sinners; but rather fear Yahweh all the day long. Indeed surely there is a future hope

sections.title: Listen
sections.text: Listen Don't be among ones drinking too much wine for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

sections.title: Listen to your father who gave you life...
sections.text: Listen to your father who gave you life Buy the truth The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him. Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well. Yes Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes? Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

sections.title: Don't look at the wine when it is red...
sections.text: Don't look at the wine when it is red In the end Your eyes will see strange things Yes They hit me

sections.title: Don't be envious of evil men; neither de...
sections.text: Don't be envious of evil men; neither desire to be with them: for their hearts plot violence Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established; by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure. A wise man has great power; and a knowledgeable man increases strength;

sections.title: for by wise guidance you wage your war; ...
sections.text: for by wise guidance you wage your war; and victory is in many advisors. Wisdom is too high for a fool: he doesn't open his mouth in the gate. One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer. The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men. If you falter in the time of trouble

sections.text: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed If you say

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul; if you have found it Don't lay in wait for a righteous man falls seven times Don't rejoice when your enemy falls. Don't let your heart be glad when he is overthrown;

sections.title: lest Yahweh see it
sections.text: lest Yahweh see it Don't fret yourself because of evildoers; neither be envious of the wicked: for there will be no reward to the evil man; and the lamp of the wicked shall be snuffed out.

sections.title: My son
sections.text: My son for their calamity will rise suddenly; the destruction from them both—who knows? These also are sayings of the wise. To show partiality in judgment is not good. He who says to the wicked but it will go well with those who convict the guilty

sections.title: An honest answer is like a kiss on the l...
sections.text: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips. Prepare your work outside Don't be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don't deceive with your lips. Don't say I went by the field of the sluggard

sections.text: These also are proverbs of Solomon It is the glory of God to conceal a thing As the heavens for height Take away the dross from the silver Take away the wicked from the king's presence

sections.title: Don't exalt yourself in the presence of ...
sections.text: Don't exalt yourself in the presence of the king for it is better that it be said to you Don't be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you? Debate your case with your neighbor lest one who hears it put you to shame

sections.title: A word fitly spoken is like apples of go...
sections.text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver. As an earring of gold As the cold of snow in the time of harvest As clouds and wind without rain By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

sections.title: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is ...
sections.text: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor's house A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth As one who takes away a garment in cold weather

sections.title: If your enemy is hungry
sections.text: If your enemy is hungry for you will heap coals of fire on his head The north wind brings forth rain: so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face. It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop Like cold water to a thirsty soul

sections.title: Like a muddied spring
sections.text: Like a muddied spring It is not good to eat much honey; nor is it honorable to seek one's own honor. Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

sections.title: Like snow in summer
sections.text: Like snow in summer Like a fluttering sparrow A whip is for the horse Don't answer a fool according to his folly Answer a fool according to his folly

sections.title: One who sends a message by the hand of a...
sections.text: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence. Like the legs of the lame that hang loose: so is a parable in the mouth of fools. As one who binds a stone in a sling Like a thornbush that goes into the hand of a drunkard As an archer who wounds all

sections.title: As a dog that returns to his vomit...
sections.text: As a dog that returns to his vomit Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him. The sluggard says As the door turns on its hinges The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

sections.title: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes th...
sections.text: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion. Like one who grabs a dog's ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own. Like a madman who shoots torches is the man who deceives his neighbor and says For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip

sections.title: As coals are to hot embers
sections.text: As coals are to hot embers The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart. A malicious man disguises himself with his lips When his speech is charming

sections.title: His malice may be concealed by deception...
sections.text: His malice may be concealed by deception Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

sections.title: Don't boast about tomorrow; for you don'...
sections.text: Don't boast about tomorrow; for you don't know what a day may bring forth. Let another man praise you A stone is heavy Wrath is cruel Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

sections.title: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; alt...
sections.text: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; although the kisses of an enemy are profuse. A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul As a bird that wanders from her nest Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man's friend. Don't forsake your friend and your father's friend. Don't go to your brother's house in the day of your disaster: better is a neighbor who is near than a distant brother.

sections.title: Be wise
sections.text: Be wise A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman! He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

sections.title: restraining her is like restraining the ...
sections.text: restraining her is like restraining the wind Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend's countenance. Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored. As water reflects a face Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man's eyes are never satisfied.

sections.title: The crucible is for silver
sections.text: The crucible is for silver Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain Know well the state of your flocks for riches are not forever The hay is removed

sections.title: The lambs are for your clothing...
sections.text: The lambs are for your clothing There will be plenty of goats' milk for your food

sections.title: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but...
sections.text: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion. In rebellion A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops. Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them. Evil men don't understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.

sections.title: Better is the poor who walks in his inte...
sections.text: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father. He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor. He who turns away his ear from hearing the law Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way

sections.title: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; bu...
sections.text: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him. When the righteous triumph He who conceals his sins doesn't prosper Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble. As a roaring lion or a charging bear

sections.title: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment...
sections.text: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days. A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him. Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly. One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty. A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
sections.summary: Lessons from creatures demonstrating wisdom and industry

sections.title: To show partiality is not good; yet a ma...
sections.text: To show partiality is not good; yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread. A stingy man hurries after riches One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue. Whoever robs his father or his mother One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.

sections.title: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but...
sections.text: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe. One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses. When the wicked rise

sections.title: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his...
sections.text: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly When the righteous thrive Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth. The king by justice makes the land stable A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

sections.title: An evil man is snared by his sin...
sections.text: An evil man is snared by his sin The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren't concerned about knowledge. Mockers stir up a city If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

sections.title: A fool vents all of his anger
sections.text: A fool vents all of his anger If a ruler listens to lies The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both. The king who fairly judges the poor The rod of correction gives wisdom

sections.text: When the wicked increase Correct your son Where there is no revelation A servant can't be corrected by words. Though he understands Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

sections.text: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end. An angry man stirs up strife A man's pride brings him low Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath The fear of man proves to be a snare

sections.title: Many seek the ruler's favor
sections.text: Many seek the ruler's favor A dishonest man detests the righteous

sections.title: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh...
sections.text: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh Surely I am the most ignorant man I have not learned wisdom Who has ascended up into heaven Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

sections.title: Don't you add to his words
sections.text: Don't you add to his words Two things I have asked of you; don't deny me before I die: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me; lest I be full Don't slander a servant to his master

sections.text: There is a generation that curses their father There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes There is a generation There is a generation whose teeth are like swords The leach has two daughters: 'Give

sections.text: Sheol The eye that mocks at his father There are three things which are too amazing for me The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent on a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maiden. So is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth

sections.title: For three things the earth tremble...
sections.text: For three things the earth tremble For a servant when he is king; a fool when he is filled with food; for an unloved woman when she is married; and a handmaid who is heir to her mistress. There are four things which are little on the earth the ants are not a strong people

sections.title: The heart of her husband trusts in her...
sections.text: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain. She does him good She seeks wool and flax She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar. She rises also while it is yet night

sections.title: She considers a field
sections.text: She considers a field She arms her waist with strength She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn't go out by night. She lays her hands to the distaff She opens her arms to the poor; yes

sections.title: She is not afraid of the snow for her ho...
sections.text: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet. She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple. Her husband is respected in the gates She makes linen garments and sells them Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

sections.title: She opens her mouth with wisdom...
sections.text: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Faithful instruction is on her tongue. She looks well to the ways of her household Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her: Many women do noble things Charm is deceitful
